title: Fujifilm X-E5 Rangefinder-Style Mirrorless Camera
purpose: Discreet, high-acutance street reportage and documentary photography leveraging 40.2MP X-Trans CMOS 5 HR resolution, dedicated Film Simulation dial, and compact pancake optics.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Fujifilm X-E5 Rangefinder Mirrorless (40.2MP APS-C X-Trans)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 40.2MP APS-C X-Trans CMOS 5 HR back-illuminated sensor with X-Processor 5
sensor_and_optics.lens: FUJINON XF 27mm f/2.8 R WR (41mm equivalent compact pancake prime)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 14.0 stops dynamic range with 14-bit RAF RAW and Film Simulation curve tuning
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Focal-plane mechanical shutter up to 1/4000s, electronic shutter to 1/180,000s, 7.0-stop IBIS

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Available natural street light, raking late-afternoon sun, or ambient urban shadow contrast
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Signature Fujifilm film simulation tonal curves (Reala Ace, Classic Chrome, Nostalgic Neg, ACROS), organic highlight roll-off, rich shadow gradations with natural micro-contrast

surface_rendering: Extreme 40.2MP APS-C micro-acutance resolving fine cobblestone weave, architectural plaster, fabric threads, and honest human facial pores without an optical low-pass filter
Authentic Fujifilm film simulation color science with tactile micro-grain structure reminiscent of silver halide film
Zero moiré artifacts owing to the randomized X-Trans color filter array pattern and high sensor pixel density
depth_and_optics: Balanced APS-C depth of field offering generous zone-focus depth at f/5.6 while maintaining gentle optical separation at f/2.8
Natural rectilinear geometry with zero distortion across the 40mm equivalent street perspective
Discreet, eye-level rangefinder-style framing capturing candid, unposed human moments

execution_directive: Enforce 40.2MP APS-C X-Trans 5 HR street rangefinder capture, authentic Fujifilm film simulation color science (Reala Ace / Classic Chrome), fine organic micro-grain, tactile urban textures, and unposed documentary timing, shot on Fujifilm X-E5.
